sourceNote: Two equally wide Quick facts columns put the planting and harvest timing on the left and depth and spacing on the right. Both units use the existing paired-facts style so that the depth qualification and the ordinary and elephant garlic spacings have room. The printed advice contains no reference to soil acidity, pH or lime. John approved the differentiated single-row bulb counts on 6 November and requested this book proof from the corrected master.
